headline: Anthropic's third-quarter revenue reportedly hits $16.8 billion
body: Anthropic told investors its third-quarter revenue stands at $16.8 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. Revenue rose from $11.6 billion in the second quarter, and Anthropic said it was profitable on an adjusted basis in the third quarter.
note: The revenue comes from people familiar with the matter, and the offering is reportedly slated for November.

evidence.text: Anthropic told investors its third-quarter revenue stands at $16.8 billion as it prepares for a highly anticipated initial public offering reportedly slated for November, according to people familiar with the matter.

Revenue rose from $11.6 billion in the second quarter, with first-quarter revenue at $4.7 billion, the people said, adding that Anthropic said it was profitable on an adjusted basis in the third quarter.
